_comment: vdd-comics-editor-uiux-lettering: canonical language <-> array-index table. Order matters -- append-only, never reorder or delete an entry, indices back the additive Images[] slot extension (Task 1.2) and must stay stable across app versions. The first three entries (en/ru/hi) are fixed by the native Cultures enum (native/Comics.Editor/Models/Cultures.cs: En=0, Ru=1, Hi=2) and are load-bearing -- do not reorder them. Seeded from apps/comics-ai-baloons/scripts/languages.py's own LANGUAGES table, same order, so the two stay index-compatible if they ever need to interoperate on the same file. This registry is intentionally data-driven: adding a language means editing this file, not shipping new Dart code.
